items.titulo: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
items.resumen: Buoyant has released Kinference, an Apache 2.0 inference control plane for vLLM on Kubernetes. It adds declarative routing policies, KV-cache-aware load balancing and per-tenant metrics, and cut median TTFT 95% in Buoyant’s own benchmark. The post Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM appeared first on MarkTechPost .
